description: A class decorator that generates `__init__`, `__repr__`, `__eq__` and optional ordering, hashing and slots from annotated fields.
Called by the generated `__init__` after fields are set; the place for validation and derived values.
Raised on assignment to a field of a `frozen=True` dataclass. It subclasses `AttributeError`.
Builds a new instance with some fields changed, running `__init__` and `__post_init__` again.
